title: PractiScale CEO - Original-footage reference library
assetType: Authentic video stills, not generated character portraits
reviewMethod: Every decoded frame reviewed in consecutive face contact sheets at original 25 fps. Selected original-resolution crops inspected individually. Contact sheets were for visual selection; no claim that every original 4K frame was enlarged individually.
processing: FFmpeg native-frame PNG extraction, then rectangular lossless crops only. No generation, face replacement, beauty retouching, reshaping, upscaling, denoising, sharpening, mirroring or background removal. Preview board alone is resized.
limits: C6876 crops retain the crown clipping already present in the source; use C6874 for complete hair outline.
C6874 is a wider shot, so its face crops contain fewer native face pixels despite the source being 4K.
Near-frontal views retain small natural head angles; they are not fabricated perfectly symmetrical front views.
Original recordings contain natural blinks and speaking. Six selected stills have open eyes; shot 03 intentionally shows a natural smile.
These photographed references preserve the recorded face; they do not guarantee exact likeness in any future generated media.

shots.label: Near-frontal / neutral
shots.purpose: Natural cheek width, brows, eyes, closed lips and beard silhouette; slight head angle retained.
